The pen costs $3. The book costs $12. The lamp costs $40.
The pen is an item. The book is an item. The lamp is an item.
The total price is the sum of the price of every item.
The average price is the average of the price of every item.
Count the items.
If something is an item and its price is more than 20 then it is expensive.
What is the total price? What is the number of items? Who is expensive?
